sentences.en: Long ago, a rich emperor loved fine new clothes.
sentences.tgt: Il:o y:o a:v longtemps:a ,:o un:o riche:a empereur:n aimait:v de:o beaux:a nouveaux:a vêtements:n .:o

sentences.en: The emperor had a new coat for each hour.
sentences.tgt: L':o empereur:n avait:v un:o nouveau:a manteau:n pour:o chaque:o heure:n .:o

sentences.en: He spent all his gold on new clothes.
sentences.tgt: Il:o dépensait:v tout:o son:o or:n en:o nouveaux:a vêtements:n .:o

sentences.en: The emperor did not care about his town.
sentences.tgt: L':o empereur:n ne:o se:o souciait:v pas:o de:o sa:o ville:n .:o

sentences.en: He did not care about his people.
sentences.tgt: Il:o ne:o se:o souciait:v pas:o de:o son:o peuple:n .:o

sentences.en: Clothes were the only thing the emperor loved.
sentences.tgt: Les:o vêtements:n étaient:v la:o seule:a chose:n que:o l':o empereur:n aimait:v .:o

sentences.en: Every morning, the emperor put on a fine coat.
sentences.tgt: Chaque:o matin:n ,:o l':o empereur:n mettait:v un:o beau:a manteau:n .:o

sentences.en: Then the emperor walked through the streets of the town.
sentences.tgt: Ensuite:o ,:o l':o empereur:n marchait:v dans:o les:o rues:n de:o la:o ville:n .:o

sentences.en: "Look at my new clothes!" the emperor said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Regardez:v mes:o nouveaux:a vêtements:n !:o »:o dit:v l':o empereur:n .:o

sentences.en: The people looked at the grand new coat.
sentences.tgt: Les:o gens:n regardèrent:v le:o grand:a nouveau:a manteau:n .:o

sentences.en: "Your clothes are so beautiful," the people said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Vos:o vêtements:n sont:v si:a beaux:a ,:o »:o dirent:v les:o gens:n .:o

sentences.en: But the emperor always wanted more new clothes.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o l':o empereur:n voulait:v toujours:a plus:o de:o nouveaux:a vêtements:n .:o

sentences.chapter: The Two Men and Their Cloth
sentences.en: One day, two men came to the town.
sentences.tgt: Un:o jour:n ,:o deux:o hommes:n arrivèrent:v dans:o la:o ville:n .:o

sentences.en: The two men said they could make beautiful cloth.
sentences.tgt: Les:o deux:o hommes:n dirent:v qu':o ils:o pouvaient:v faire:v un:o tissu:n magnifique:a .:o

sentences.en: "Our cloth is very beautiful," the men said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Notre:o tissu:n est:v très:a beau:a ,:o »:o dirent:v les:o hommes:n .:o

sentences.en: "But our cloth is also special," said one man.
sentences.tgt: «:o Mais:o notre:o tissu:n est:v aussi:a spécial:a ,:o »:o dit:v un:o homme:n .:o

sentences.en: "Only clever people can see this cloth," the man said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Seules:a les:o personnes:n intelligentes:a peuvent:v voir:v ce:o tissu:n ,:o »:o dit:v l':o homme:n .:o

sentences.en: "A foolish person sees nothing at all," he said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Une:o personne:n stupide:a ne:o voit:v rien:o du:o tout:o ,:o »:o dit:v -il:o .:o

sentences.en: The emperor heard about the special cloth.
sentences.tgt: L':o empereur:n entendit:v parler:v du:o tissu:n spécial:a .:o

sentences.en: "I must have this special cloth!" the emperor said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o dois:v avoir:v ce:o tissu:n spécial:a !:o »:o dit:v l':o empereur:n .:o

sentences.en: "Then I will see who is foolish," he said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Alors:o je:o verrai:v qui:o est:v stupide:a ,:o »:o dit:v -il:o .:o

sentences.en: The emperor wanted the cloth more than his gold.
sentences.tgt: L':o empereur:n voulait:v le:o tissu:n plus:a que:o son:o or:n .:o

sentences.en: The emperor told the two men to make it.
sentences.tgt: L':o empereur:n dit:v aux:o deux:o hommes:n de:o le:o faire:v .:o

sentences.en: "I will give you lots of gold," the emperor said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o vous:o donnerai:v beaucoup:a d':o or:n ,:o »:o dit:v l':o empereur:n .:o

sentences.en: The emperor gave the two men a bag of gold.
sentences.tgt: L':o empereur:n donna:v aux:o deux:o hommes:n un:o sac:n d':o or:n .:o

sentences.en: He also gave them fine silk and gold thread.
sentences.tgt: Il:o leur:o donna:v aussi:a de:o la:o belle:a soie:n et:o du:o fil:n d':o or:n .:o

sentences.en: The two men made two looms for the cloth.
sentences.tgt: Les:o deux:o hommes:n fabriquèrent:v deux:o métiers:n à:o tisser:v pour:o le:o tissu:n .:o

sentences.en: But the two men put nothing on the looms.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o les:o deux:o hommes:n ne:o mirent:v rien:o sur:o les:o métiers:n .:o

sentences.en: The looms were empty all day and night.
sentences.tgt: Les:o métiers:n étaient:v vides:a toute:o la:o journée:n et:o toute:o la:o nuit:n .:o

sentences.en: The two men only pretended to work.
sentences.tgt: Les:o deux:o hommes:n ne:o faisaient:v que:o semblant:n de:o travailler:v .:o

sentences.en: They kept the silk and gold.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o gardèrent:v la:o soie:n et:o l':o or:n .:o

sentences.en: The two men did no work at all.
sentences.tgt: Les:o deux:o hommes:n ne:o firent:v aucun:o travail:n .:o

sentences.en: The emperor wanted to see his beautiful cloth.
sentences.tgt: L':o empereur:n voulait:v voir:v son:o beau:a tissu:n .:o

sentences.en: But the emperor was afraid to look.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o l':o empereur:n avait:v peur:n de:o regarder:v .:o

sentences.en: "Can I see the cloth?" the emperor thought.
sentences.tgt: «:o Puis:v -je:o voir:v le:o tissu:n ?:o »:o pensa:v l':o empereur:n .:o

sentences.en: The emperor sent his old minister to look.
sentences.tgt: L':o empereur:n envoya:v son:o vieux:a ministre:n pour:o regarder:v .:o

sentences.en: The old minister came to see the two men.
sentences.tgt: Le:o vieux:a ministre:n vint:v voir:v les:o deux:o hommes:n .:o

sentences.en: The minister looked hard at the two looms.
sentences.tgt: Le:o ministre:n regarda:v attentivement:a les:o deux:o métiers:n à:o tisser:v .:o

sentences.en: But the minister saw no cloth on the looms.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o le:o ministre:n ne:o vit:v pas:o de:o tissu:n sur:o les:o métiers:n à:o tisser:v .:o

sentences.en: "These looms are empty!" the minister thought.
sentences.tgt: «:o Ces:o métiers:n sont:v vides:a !:o »:o pensa:v le:o ministre:n .:o

sentences.en: "Am I a foolish old man?" the minister asked.
sentences.tgt: «:o Suis-je:v un:o vieil:a homme:n stupide:a ?:o »:o demanda:v le:o ministre:n .:o

sentences.en: But he did not want to seem foolish.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o il:o ne:o voulait:v pas:o paraître:v stupide:a .:o

sentences.en: "What fine colors this cloth has!" the minister said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Quelles:o belles:a couleurs:n ce:o tissu:n a:v !:o »:o dit:v le:o ministre:n .:o

sentences.en: The two men pointed at the empty looms.
sentences.tgt: Les:o deux:o hommes:n pointèrent:v les:o métiers:n vides:a .:o

sentences.en: Then the minister hurried back to the happy emperor.
sentences.tgt: Puis:o le:o ministre:n se:o dépêcha:v de:o retourner:v vers:o le:o joyeux:a empereur:n .:o

sentences.en: "The new cloth is so beautiful," the minister said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Le:o nouveau:a tissu:n est:v si:a beau:a ,:o »:o dit:v le:o ministre:n .:o

sentences.en: The emperor was very glad to hear this.
sentences.tgt: L':o empereur:n fut:v très:a content:a d':o entendre:v cela:o .:o

sentences.en: Now the emperor wanted to see the cloth himself.
sentences.tgt: Maintenant:a l':o empereur:n voulait:v voir:v le:o tissu:n lui-même:o .:o

sentences.en: The next day, the emperor went to the looms.
sentences.tgt: Le:o lendemain:n ,:o l':o empereur:n alla:v aux:o métiers:n à:o tisser:v .:o

sentences.en: Many of his men came with him.
sentences.tgt: Beaucoup:a de:o ses:o hommes:n vinrent:v avec:o lui:o .:o

sentences.en: But the emperor saw nothing on the looms!
sentences.tgt: Mais:o l':o empereur:n ne:o vit:v rien:o sur:o les:o métiers:n à:o tisser:v !:o

sentences.en: The emperor was afraid to seem foolish.
sentences.tgt: L':o empereur:n avait:v peur:n de:o paraître:v sot:a .:o

sentences.en: "Oh, what wonderful clothes!" the emperor said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Oh:o ,:o quels:o merveilleux:a habits:n !:o »:o dit:v l':o empereur:n .:o

sentences.en: "Yes, the cloth is so beautiful!" his men said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Oui:o ,:o le:o tissu:n est:v si:a beau:a !:o »:o dirent:v ses:o hommes:n .:o

sentences.en: But his men also saw nothing at all.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o ses:o hommes:n ne:o virent:v rien:o non:o plus:o .:o

sentences.en: The men did not want to seem foolish.
sentences.tgt: Les:o hommes:n ne:o voulaient:v pas:o paraître:v sots:a .:o

sentences.en: Then the two men dressed the emperor with care.
sentences.tgt: Puis:o les:o deux:o hommes:n habillèrent:v l':o empereur:n avec:o soin:n .:o

sentences.en: The emperor looked at himself in the mirror.
sentences.tgt: L':o empereur:n se:o regarda:v dans:o le:o miroir:n .:o

sentences.en: But the emperor saw no clothes on his body.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o l':o empereur:n ne:o vit:v aucun:o habit:n sur:o son:o corps:n .:o

sentences.en: "These new clothes look so fine," the emperor said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Ces:o nouveaux:a habits:n semblent:v si:a beaux:a ,:o »:o dit:v l':o empereur:n .:o

sentences.en: The next morning, the emperor walked through the town.
sentences.tgt: Le:o lendemain:n matin:n ,:o l':o empereur:n marcha:v dans:o la:o ville:n .:o

sentences.en: But the emperor had no clothes on his body.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o l':o empereur:n n':o avait:v pas:o de:o vêtements:n sur:o son:o corps:n .:o

sentences.en: All the people came out to the street.

sentences.en: "Look at the grand new clothes!" the people said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Regardez:v les:o grands:a habits:n neufs:a !:o »:o dirent:v les:o gens:n .:o

sentences.en: "The fine colors are so beautiful!" a man said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Les:o fines:a couleurs:n sont:v si:a belles:a !:o »:o dit:v un:o homme:n .:o

sentences.en: No one wanted to seem foolish.
sentences.tgt: Personne:o ne:o voulait:v paraître:v sot:a .:o

sentences.en: Every person said the cloth looked wonderful.
sentences.tgt: Chaque:o personne:n dit:v que:o le:o tissu:n semblait:v merveilleux:a .:o

sentences.en: Then a young child saw the emperor.
sentences.tgt: Alors:o un:o jeune:a enfant:n vit:v l':o empereur:n .:o

sentences.en: "But the emperor has no clothes on!" the child cried.

sentences.en: The people heard the young child and looked.

sentences.en: "The child tells the truth!" they all said.

sentences.en: The emperor knew the truth but walked on.
sentences.tgt: L':o empereur:n connaissait:v la:o vérité:n mais:o continua:v à:o marcher:v .:o
